name: list_vscheduler_commands
description: List the vscheduler commands this server is permitted to run, with their arguments. Useful when the user asks what is available.

name: valloc
description:
Allocate a general-pool compute node to a user and create the matching Guacamole connection. CHANGES allocation state. Both node and user are required so an allocation is never made against every node at once.

This command CHANGES scheduler state. Confirm the exact target with the user before calling it.

node.description: compute node to allocate, e.g. node01. Required.
node.title: Node

user.description: Username to allocate the node to. Required.
user.title: User

name: vinfo
description: Overview of every partition and compute node: which nodes exist, their pool (general vs bookable) and their current status, read from the report database. Read-only and safe. Call this first to find out what nodes exist before using any command that needs a node name.

name: vkill
description:
Log a user off a compute node, terminating their session. MUTATING AND NOT REVERSIBLE - the session's unsaved state is lost, and the command does not prompt for confirmation. Node and user are both required: vkill with no node logs off EVERY user on EVERY node in every configured partition. Always confirm the exact node and username with the operator before calling, and prefer vinfo first to see who is logged in.

This command CHANGES scheduler state. Confirm the exact target with the user before calling it.

node.description: compute node hosting the session, e.g. node03. Required.
node.title: Node

user.description: Username whose session to terminate. Required.
user.title: User

name: vmanage
description:
Reconcile one bookable-partition node against its LibreBooking reservations: grant access to a user whose booking has started, and revoke it when the booking has ended. CHANGES access. The node must be inside the configured bookable range or the command refuses it.

This command CHANGES scheduler state. Confirm the exact target with the user before calling it.

node.description: Target compute node, e.g. node03. Required.
node.title: Node

anyOf.description: Limit the reconcile to a single username.

name: vquota
description: Show booking quota usage. Read-only. With no arguments it checks every user against every node; narrow it with user and/or node.

anyOf.description: Check the quota of one username.
Check quota against one compute node.

name: vreport
description: Usage report of node sessions from the report database. Read-only. With no arguments it reports on every node and user over the whole database. Narrow it with user, node, or a date range.

anyOf.description: Restrict the report to one username.
Restrict the report to one compute node, e.g. node03.
Date bracket as two YYYY-MM-DD values separated by a space, e.g. "2026-01-01 2026-03-31". Supplying one date uses today as the end. Only vreport honours a date range.

name: vscheduler_health
description: Check that the MCP server can reach the vscheduler service over SSH. Call this first when a command fails for an unclear reason.

name: vset
description:
Set the administrative status of one compute node. CHANGES whether the scheduler will hand the node out. 'maint' takes it out of service, 'up' returns it to service. Without a node the command does nothing, so node is required here.

This command CHANGES scheduler state. Confirm the exact target with the user before calling it.

node.description: compute node whose status to set, e.g. node02. Required.
node.title: Node

status.description: New status. Passed as a bare word after the node, which is what initiate.py expects. 'up' = idle/in service, 'down' = offline, 'maint' = maintenance, 'dev' = talks to dev-vscheduler, 'allocated' = has a logged-in user, 'reserved' = booked.
status.title: Status

name: vsync
description:
Synchronise Guacamole connections, users and permissions with the current pool state. CHANGES the Guacamole database. Node is required so a sync is scoped to one node rather than the whole estate.

This command CHANGES scheduler state. Confirm the exact target with the user before calling it.

anyOf.description: Limit the sync to one username.
